title: Birdlife International
definition: A global partnership of non-governmental organizations (NGOs) that strives to conserve birds, their habitats, and global biodiversity by working with people towards sustainability in the use of natural resources.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently linked to Environment and Ecology (GS-III), specifically regarding biodiversity conservation, international environmental governance, and indicator species for climate change.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Birdlife International.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
